blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — The sea turtle nesting season began early in the coastal town of Sariaya, Quezon, with 95 eggs collected Friday morning along the shores of Tayabas Bay. Edwin Frias, a deputized “bantay dagat (fish warden) member, said the eggs were found along the shoreline of Barangay Bignay 2 at around 5 a.m. “This is only the start of the nesting season,” Frias told the Inquirer in an online interview.
